title: Legendary Creator Returns With a New Look At The Manga Perfect Story For 2026
content: Naoki Urasawa is one of the most legendary manga creators of all time. Almost all of his works are always praised among readers for their exceptional art style and storytelling. While the creator is best known for Monster, a 1994 manga, he has also worked on more than a dozen titles.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll’s Biggest Isekai Has a Disappointing Update After Its Return
content: The highly anticipated Spring 2026 anime season is finally over, and fans now have to bid farewell to some of their favorite shows. However, this doesn’t include Re:Zero − Starting Life in Another World Season 4, which continues Subaru’s journey.
author: ComicBook

title: Tank Chair Anime Reveals Main Trailer, Theme Opening Song by SiM, New Cast, October 4 Premiere
content: TANK CHAIR anime revealed its key visual and main trailer, along with an October 4, 2026 premiere date. The anime also introduced additional cast members and confirmed SiM and Daoko as the theme song artists. Two new cast members were announced: • Yurina Amami as Dr.
author: Anime Corner

title: Crunchyroll’s Solo Leveling Replacement Continues to Outdo Solo Leveling
content: Solo Leveling is undoubtedly one of the best modern action anime to arrive on Crunchyroll in recent years, and much like its manhwa, the anime has sparked a wave of similar series. In Solo Leveling ‘s absence this year, Crunchyroll has introduced a new anime that bears many similarities to it.
author: ComicBook

title: Skull Dragon's Precious Daughter Manga Goes on Hiatus for Half a Year
content: J-Novel Club releases the manga digitally, and Seven Seas Entertainment publishes the manga in print. J-Novel Club describes the story: In the Forest of Scraps, a place where all manner of things are discarded, an old dragon sleeps away his final days—that is, until an abandoned child suddenly appears before him.
author: ANN

title: Gundam: Kenji Kamiyama Talks Creating New AA Universe, And How It Will Change The Franchise
content: The Gundam franchise might have first started in the 1970s, but the mech universe has continued thanks to its versatility. While the original Universal Century storyline introduced viewers to the war between the Earth Federation and the Principality of Zeon, countless other stories have emerged.
author: ComicBook

title: Battle in 5 Seconds Goes on Hiatus Due to Author's Poor Health
content: Miyakokasiwa previously went on hiatus in October 2024, noting health and personal issues since the start of 2024, and added that the series is approaching its end. The manga resumed serialization in January 2025.
author: ANN

title: Solo Leveling: Ragnarok Confirms a New U.S. Release in 2027 Amid Indefinite Hiatus
content: It’s been several months since the Solo Leveling : Ragnarok manhwa went on an indefinite hiatus. Following the second season’s finale in January this year, the lead artist, Jin, had to be enlisted in mandatory military service.

title: Duel Masters GT Manga's 3rd Part Launches
content: Hiroki Kikuzuma and Daisuke Kawasaki launched the third part of their Duel Masters GT manga on Shogakukan 's Weekly CoroCoro Comic manga website on Wednesday. The new manga is titled Duel Masters GT3 -Glitch of the Twin heart- .
author: ANN

title: Kei Yose's The Villainess Speaks Not Light Novels Get Manga Adaptation
content: Overlap's Comic Gardo website launched on Wednesday the manga adaptation of Kei Yose 's The Villainess Speaks Not ( Akuyaku Reijō wa Shaberimasen ) novel by artist Ryū Miduki. J-Novel Club releases the novel series in English digitally, and describes the story: They tried to silence her, but she doesn't need a voice…
